_about: THE CRM'S OWN HELP (dev kit part 3): the tour steps and the questions in the Help center. When the same question arrives in the feedback inbox twice (kind 'A question'), add it here with its answer. ids are lower-case words and hyphens and NEVER change once used: the open counts are kept per id (table help_faq_opens). Answers are plain text, and every answer must say what the CRM really does.

tour.title: The left card
tour.body: Everything in Intake is one click away here. The numbers show what is waiting.

tour.title: Inbox
tour.body: Every new message from every channel lands here first, in the column of the day it arrived. Make a lead: say the programme and the next step on the card. Anything else: Set aside. Kept, never deleted.

tour.title: Today
tour.body: Who needs an action now: overdue, due today, and people with no next step. Press Done, say how it went and choose the next step. Drag a card to Due today or Coming up to move its step to another day.

tour.title: Journey
tour.body: Everyone you are working with, stage by stage, up to Admitted or Not proceeding. Search, add a lead, filter by where they came from.

tour.title: Light, System or Dark
tour.body: Choose how Intake looks. System follows your computer.

tour.title: Stuck, or have an idea?
tour.body: The Feedback button is on every screen. The Help center has this tour and the answers to questions about Intake.

faq.a: No. Nobody is deleted. When someone is not going ahead, close them as Not proceeding with a reason. They stay on record on the Journey, under Not proceeding. The original messages and call records behind them are kept for 13 months.

faq.q: What does "late" mean in the Inbox?
faq.a: Nobody has handled the message by the end of the working day it should have been answered in. Working hours are Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 Riga time. One working hour after it arrived the card first says "answer now"; a message that arrives in the evening or at the weekend counts from the next working morning.

faq.q: How do I move someone along?
faq.a: On Journey, drag the person to the next stage when something real has happened. Click a person to see their details and their next step.

faq.q: Where do the Home numbers come from?
faq.a: From the people in Intake, counted for the years ticked in the Year filter, top right: this year when you open Intake, or any years together. Click a Home number to see it one level deeper, and the people it counts. On Reports, the Whole year box shows one month of those years instead. Download on the Journey or on Reports gives the figures as Excel, Google Sheets or CSV.

faq.q: Can I send someone a link to a person?
faq.a: Yes. Copy the address from the browser and send it. Anyone with an Intake account opens it; if they are signed out, they sign in first and then land on it.

Use the Light, System, Dark switch at the bottom of the left card (on a phone, at the bottom of the page). System follows your computer, and changes when it does. The choice is remembered on this device.

faq.q: Can I install it as an app?
faq.a: Yes. In Chrome or Edge, click the install icon at the right end of the address bar. Intake then opens in its own window, with the Academy logo on the desktop and the taskbar.
Press Report a problem above, or the Feedback button in the corner. You can add a screenshot. It reaches the people who build Intake.
